scope: XOCE local website native product screenshots and official Pebble Appstore device frame
notes: All four images were copied byte-for-byte from versioned project evidence.
These are native emulator renderings, not physical-watch photography or browser design mock-ups.
Some presentations place unchanged native captures inside the official Pebble Appstore Time 2 frame; catalogue and documentation views may display the captures directly.
Dashboard reuses an older capture of its unchanged watch layout; that reuse is identified in its entry.
